note: Both sets capture the same six core facts with supporting quotes, including the 2500/2900 gram pull forces, 400 gram total actuation force, 10 gram per-louver limit, and the 200C-to-cryogenic transformation range. The key difference is the condition attached to the 15-20C austenite range: Set A correctly notes it was established from annual temperature data for Irvine, CA during the competition period, while Set B misbinds it to the existing Dynalloy wire specification (the text says the range merely fell within that specification). Set A is therefore slightly more faithful, with no misattributed conditions.
